study.join: CELL_ID, unique and complete, all 197756 coordinates checked against projection and frozen transform

fieldSemantics.FOREST_AT_RISK_HA: Source study forest-at-risk area in hectares; eligibility >=5 ha. Independent of the later forest backdrop.
fieldSemantics.RISK_PRIORITY_PERCENTILE: Frozen relative priority ranking, not a probability.
fieldSemantics.WARNING_SELECTION_FRACTION: Existing fractional selection, copied without reranking.
fieldSemantics.MAP_DATA_STATUS: ELIGIBLE_PREDICTED, MODEL_ROW_BUT_LT5HA and NO_2018_MODEL_ROW retained separately.
fieldSemantics.CONVERSION_NEXT_2YR_HA: Recorded permanent forest conversion during2019–2020 in available2018 study rows, including rows below5ha model eligibility. This observed outcome is separate from the frozen ranking and warning allocation; missing remains missing. Specific causes are not identified.

columns.48: Float64 original PREDICTION_YEAR (NaN for absent row)

binary.identifier: CELL_ID is losslessly reconstructed as Borneo1k_${GRID_COL}_${GRID_ROW}; verified for every source row.
binary.missing: Source nonfinite values remain IEEE NaN; never zero.

displayScope.name: Sabah, Sarawak and Brunei
displayScope.processing: Display-context mask is the union of verified Natural Earth Sabah, Sarawak, Labuan and Brunei admin polygons. Indonesian context is hidden at user request. Frozen study cells are not clipped, reranked or changed. Resource-coordinate bounds remain the original LAEA bounds; only camera framing and background context change.

map.height: Terrain elevation only; overview 12x vertical scale. Forest illustration uses separate flat ground.

classes.6: Other land cover including no data and non-TMF cover

forest.encoding: RGBA: class1 proportion, class2 proportion, class4 proportion, class1..6 published-category coverage proportion; byte/255. Alpha is NOT a valid-observation rate; class6 includes no-data.
forest.aggregation: Display pixel fraction approximation: each original discrete pixel is classified first and counted in 8x8 source blocks. Each4096 display pixel integrates16 stratified locations over those class-fraction blocks; a512x512 inverse-coordinate mesh is bilinearly interpolated, with no interpolation of raw class identifiers. The2048 tier is an exact area-weighted box average of4096 display fractions. Native30m classification is not changed or used to modify model data. Pixel-count fractions used within small8x8 blocks.
forest.limitation: Class6 combines other land cover and no data in the published AnnualChange product; these cannot be separated. Forest is a retrospective reconstruction, independent of frozen model scores and warning allocation. The texture is a display approximation, not an analytical forest-area raster.

terrain.encoding: float32 little endian; north-to-south rows; metres above sea level; negative sea elevations retained; renderer clamps sea to zero

activity.interpretation: Display-only aggregation of recorded outcomes. State callouts show the largest recorded50km study block in each state, not a state total or point event. Brunei is context only.

experience.purpose: Two illustrative decisions, not a model-performance evaluation

illustrativeForest.researchDataBinding: Illustrative density scales with 2018 FOREST_AT_RISK_HA / 100; not measured tree counts or protected area.
illustrativeForest.geometry: Authored lightweight branches and photographed CC0 leaf cards; not a site survey.

sources.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles / Terrarium
sources.attribution: Terrain Tiles by Mapzen, hosted on AWS. SRTM/GMTED2010 terrain courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; global ETOPO1 terrain courtesy of NOAA. Full source terms: https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
sources.processing: Terrarium raw RGB decoded by R*256+G+B/256-32768. No colour correction. Reprojected to WGS84 ellipsoidal LAEA, centre114E/3N; bilinear elevation sampling; local Float32 grid.

sources.name: Natural Earth 1:10m land and admin-1
sources.processing: Select Borneo main island by contains(114E,0N), retain coastal islands within 0.35 degrees of source coast; reproject to LAEA; simplify at90m; rasterize using even-odd rings. Administrative outlines are geographical context only.

sources.name: JRC Tropical Moist Forest Annual Change
sources.attribution: European Commission, Joint Research Centre (JRC), Tropical Moist Forest dataset, v1_2025. Vancutsem et al. (2021), Long-term (1990–2019) monitoring of forest cover changes in the humid tropics, Science Advances 7:eabe1603.
sources.license: Free of charge without restriction of use; acknowledge JRC dataset and journal article.
sources.processing: Single-year AnnualChange_2018 downloads from current v1_2025 official download interface; official Annual Change classes1..6 (guide pp10–11), forest classes1/2/4. Later historical reconstruction, not an input available in2018. Never intersects or changes frozen study selection.
